claims.A6: A find_spec('aminx') availability guard returns True for any installed package named aminx, including a hub with no scoring module, so the guard's friendly ImportError path is bypassed.

prereg.question: If a hub project ever installed a top-level Python package named aminx, would the real find_spec('aminx') guard used by asr's vendored proteinsmc report MPNN as available and then fail late? (This is the reason the hub must never take the import name aminx.)
prereg.expect_if_true: control_no_aminx has AMINX_AVAILABLE false and a ModuleNotFoundError at the call site; toy_hub_named_aminx_present has AMINX_AVAILABLE true and a ModuleNotFoundError naming aminx.scoring at the call site.
prereg.expect_if_false: The toy hub leaves AMINX_AVAILABLE false (the guard is already robust and the reserved-name rule in S3-24 is unnecessary), or the control reports true (probe invalid), or the guard line is not found.
